73. Observance of judicial restraint is currently the mood in England.
The judicial power of review is exercised to rein in any unbridled executive functioning.
The restraint has to contemporary manifestations.
One is the ambit of judicial intervention; the other covers the scope of the court's ability to quash an administrative decision on its merits.
These restrains bear the hallmarks of judicial control over administrative action.
Judicial review is concerned with reviewing not the merits of the decision in support of which the application for judicial review is made, but the decision- making process itself.

28. Here, it will be apposite to mention that NHAI is a professionally managed statutory body having expertise in the field of development and maintenance of National Highways.

The projects involving construction of new highways and widening and development of the existing highways,

sentences.text: 33. Apart therefrom, the SLAO is not a competent authority to decide on this matter.

In terms of Sub- section (a) of Section 3 of NHAI Act, the competent authority is defined as under:
" 3. Definitions.- in this Act, unless the context otherwise requires,-
(a) "Competent Authority" means any person or authority authorized by the Central Government, by notification in the official Gazette, to perform the functions of the competent authority for such area as may be specified in the notification;"
34.
The SLAO not being the Competent authority, the Competent Authority has considered all the aspects and issued the impugned endorsement.

The petitioners having approached this Court once earlier in W.P.No.200028/2023, this Court vide its order dated 28.08.2023 had directed respondent Nos.7 and 8 therein to consider the recommendation made by the SLAO within an outer limit of four weeks.

It is in pursuance thereof,
an endorsement dated 13.09.2023 at Annexure-R has been issued.

Though technically such an endorsement cannot be said to be a well-reasoned consideration, I am of the further considered opinion that the same cannot be said to be unreasoned, inasmuch as it is categorically stated in the endorsement that:
"......... the subject project is a part of Economic Corridor-20 i.e. Hassan to Raichur section of NH-167.
Further, change in alignment will require acquisition of new Survey Nos.(66 nos.).
Also, if alignment is changed, it will affect length of 5.1kms (village Deosugur and Ganjhalli) of original alignment for which 3A & 3D is already completed.
Also, CALA of the project i.e. SLAO, NHAI, Bagalkot has declared award of village Deosugur on 02.08.2023.
Hence, local farmers/ villagers may object change in alignment and will stop the work as they are aware of the 3A, 3D Notificatons published in local newspapers.
Further, as the 3D Notification is already published in the - 46 - NC: 2024:KHC-K:7570 Central Gazette as per NH Act 1956, the land vests with the Central Govt. free from all encumbrances.

So, at this stage, the representation/
recommendation made by the SLAO CALA for change of alignment and the representations submitted by petitioners cannot be considered.
Further, it is to mention here that, Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Union of India Vs Kushala Shetty has upheld that, in the technical matters the NHAI is the expert.

36. The reasons which have been given in the said paragraph to my mind is sufficient to reject the request of the petitioners to change the alignment in order to save their own land.

37. Petitioner Nos.1 and 2 being father and son have sufficient land which would still be available after the acquisition is completed to enable the petitioners to establish at least a Rural Health Center, which they would be free to do.

If the land is not sufficient for setting up of a Naturopathy Center, they could from and out of the compensation received, always set it - 47 - NC: 2024:KHC-K:7570 up in any other location or by purchasing the adjoining land.

Merely because the petitioners want to set up such a state of the art Naturopathy center would not be a ground to deviate from a project of public importance namely, Economic Corridor-20 i.e. the Hassan to Raichur Section of NH-167.
The requirement of a National Highway serves a larger public purpose than that espoused by the Petitioners.
38. Thus, looked at from any angle, there are no grounds made out in the above petition requiring interference at the hands of this Court to set aside or to quash the acquisition proceedings.
39. This petition is therefore dismissed.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The NHAI being an independent authority having prepared the project report as regards the present alignment has taken into consideration all the relevant factors, merely because the petitioners want to establish a naturopathy center would not be a ground to change the alignment.
There is no composite plan ever envisaged by petitioner Nos.1 and 2 to set up either a rural health center or a naturopathy center in the entire land.
For such purpose, the entire land acquisition process would have to commence from the scratch.
This would delay the project by more than a year, considering the various elaborate procedures involved in land acquisition.
Any challenge to such acquisition would cause further delay in the project.
Delay in land acquisition would delay project execution, leading to disputes, compensation and additional expenditure.
17. In the present case, the authorities of NHAI sought to acquire the land and the purpose of acquisition being public one, the project being for public purpose, the implementation of the project being made by NHAI in furtherance of public interest are not in dispute.
The said report was considered by the competent authority, however, the authority - 35 - NC: 2024:KHC-K:7570 rejected the report on the ground that the entire proceedings have been completed and now there could be no such change made in the alignment or acquisition.
The alignment having been made by the NHAI in a curved manner, it is contended by the petitioners that if it is straightened, the land of the petitioners could S. Rajender Reddy And Anr vs National Highways Authority Of India ... on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27694881/
15 be saved from acquisition.
Thus, in my considered opinion, the claim of petitioner No.2 to set up a Naturopathy center and/or a Rural Health Center is only an afterthought made with an intention to try and save their lands from acquisition, this, at the cost of shifting the - 38 - NC: 2024:KHC-K:7570 alignment which would result in the acquisition of lands belonging to certain others.
Furthermore, a perusal of the plan which has been submitted for changing the alignment would only indicate that by such change, the road is brought to the doorstep of the property of the petitioners enabling the petitioners to have access to the National Highway and the benefit thereof while the petitioners are seeking exemption S. Rajender Reddy And Anr vs National Highways Authority Of India ... on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27694881/
16 from their land being acquired.
Further, as the 3D Notification is already published in the - 46 - NC: 2024:KHC-K:7570 Central Gazette as per NH Act 1956, the land vests with the Central Govt. free from all encumbrances.
So, at this stage, the representation/
recommendation made by the SLAO CALA for change of alignment and the representations submitted by petitioners cannot be considered.
As such the S. Rajender Reddy And Anr vs National Highways Authority Of India ... on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27694881/
19 road alignment is approved by taking all the technical aspects into consideration, the project is in advanced stage and hence it is not feasible to change the alignment.
37. Petitioner Nos.1 and 2 being father and son have sufficient land which would still be available after the acquisition is completed to enable the petitioners to establish at least a Rural Health Center, which they would be free to do.
If the land is not sufficient for setting up of a Naturopathy Center, they could from and out of the compensation received, always set it - 47 - NC: 2024:KHC-K:7570 up in any other location or by purchasing the adjoining land.
Merely because the petitioners want to set up such a state of the art Naturopathy center would not be a ground to deviate from a project of public importance namely, Economic Corridor-20 i.e. the Hassan to Raichur Section of NH-167.
The requirement of a National Highway serves a larger public purpose than that espoused by the Petitioners.
